entry.name: framesnap~
entry.digest: Output an FFT frame or signal vector as a list
entry.description: The framesnap~ object is similar to snapshot~ but outputs a list with the contents of a signal vector convenient for capturing an FFT frame when used inside a pfft~ object.

arguments.name: interval
arguments.description: An optional number argument sets the internal sampling interval in milliseconds. If the argument is 0 or not present,will not generate output automatically. In this case, you will need to send amessage to output a frame of signal data.

messages.description: Any message that conforms to a Max time format message (e.g.,,,,, or,) can be used to specify the internal sampling interval used by theobject.

messages.name: bang
messages.digest: Trigger a frame or signal vector
messages.description: message produces a list containing the contents of the current signal vector.

messages.name: float
messages.digest: Enables automatic reporting; sets input sampling interval
messages.description: (In left inlet) Sending a non-zero number to the left inlet starts the object's automatic reporting of signal values. A zero received in the left inlet stops automatic reporting.(In right inlet) A number sent to the right inlet of theobject sets the internal sampling interval in milliseconds. If the interval is set to 0,will not generate output automatically. In this case, you will need to send amessage to output a frame of signal data.

messages.name: int
messages.digest: Enables automatic reporting; sets input sampling interval

messages.name: list
messages.description: Any message that conforms to the Max time format (,,,,, or) can be used to specify the internal sampling interval used by theobject.

messages.name: sampleinterval
messages.description: The word, followed by an integer, sets the internal sampling interval in milliseconds.

messages.name: signal
messages.description: A signal connected to theobject's left inlet will used to output a list when the object receives aor its internal sample interval clock fires.

messages.name: start
messages.description: The messagestarts theobject's automatic output if the sample interval is non-zero. If the sample output is zero, themessage is equivalent to themessage, causing a single signal vector output.

messages.name: stop
messages.description: The messagestops theobject from automatic output if its sample interval is non-zero.

outlets.description: When used outside of aobject, theobject will output the contents of a signal vector. When used inside of aobject, the signal vector thatoutputs represents a spectral frame. The size of the list is dependent on the signal vector size when used outside of aobject. When used inside of aobject, the list size will be equal to the FFT frame size.
